specification_gaps.detail: No history/eligibility field or pre-check endpoint. Do not invent one; use only established same-call receipt/history and qualify unknown history.
Masked middle digits cannot support last-six equality/matching. Full production card data and test data differ; safely retain ambiguity.
Analysis/kickoff owner IVR login versus example5 main menu. Both forbid third-party info/effects; routing mapping needs explicit host contract.
No exact approved timeout. Official delay12 seconds must succeed; avoid automatic retry for side effects.
PDF contract requires currencyType while general email business flow does not specify a choice across owing currencies. Do not infer a conversion.
Analysis4.7 explicitly leaves future-period foreign totals open; do not score invented mandatory foreign readout.
Currency disclosure before TL is required when transferAmount>0; exact sentence remains draft and fixtures do not cover it.

generic_builder_recommendations.fix: Build clause-level authority/provenance with source date, speaker and confirmed/retracted status. Supply every case-folder source; directory order alone cannot resolve quoted emails or reversals inside one meeting.

generic_builder_recommendations.target: Generic runtime state and dispatch guards
generic_builder_recommendations.fix: Bind side-effect consent to operation, exact owned cardNumber, issued statement/currency/registered recipient or complete preview dates, joint impact and revision. Parse full reply corrections first; clear consent on any retargeting.
Keep service acceptance separate from business authorization; support already-identified input identity and server-only customer binding without reusing debt-collection security gates.

Preserve exact request envelope and cardNumber from list, current statementDay for both preview/change, alternate due-date field names, string change fields, HTTP plus result success, service-specific warning/error routes.

Use injected local now and service-backed dates. Separate issued/next/preview dates; preserve decimal numbers and signed credit semantics. Missing currency is unknown, not zero. Do not reuse holiday-shifting collection calendars.

Represent another-card ordering, no-debt branch, suspended out-of-scope question, question-local tries, independent silence/anger, repeat requests and immediate human/payment/dispute transfer priorities.

Require executable syntax and no merge markers before generation; validate generated operation paths and schemas against immutable source fixtures. Preserve generator provenance; repair builder sources and regenerate, never patch candidate JSON.
